name: jpc-file-sorter
description: Jay Paul Company File Sorter: one decision per unique file, recorded to a spreadsheet. Never moves or deletes files.
whatsNew: Holding a key, double-pressing, or pressing Enter on a focused button no longer sorts files by accident; the number pad works with NumLock off; a Keyboard on/off switch turns single-key shortcuts off
Saving rebuilt: two open tabs can't overwrite each other, and a failed save says 'Not saved' instead of 'Offline'
Undo can no longer erase someone else's later Review edit or review mark; only TW or KB can mark reviewed
Backups: the day's first backup is never overwritten, reset needs a verified backup first, and every backup can be downloaded
Notes have Save and Cancel buttons and are never thrown away by clicking elsewhere
Keypad home numbers are given when a folder is chosen; a folder decision counts once
Use http://localhost:8765 for the local app (needed for Microsoft sign-in later)
